title: A stopped or cut Help answer is restored as stopped or cut, with Retry
steps: Stream a Help answer the provider cuts after two words, and one the asker stops; read the conversation back.
Restore those turns in the Help client.
expect: The stored answers keep their words with ended cut / stopped; a finished answer has no ended field.
The client restores status error + error.cut and status stopped; a finished one is done.

tests: Help: an answer the asker stopped, or the provider cut
restore keeps a stopped answer stopped and a cut one cut
